chore(ci): Use `wasm-pack --no-gitignore` (#2011)

The problem we fixed in #1919 was this:

> I tried to switch to the released version of the @maplibre/mlt-wasm
NPM package, but I found it doesn't contain the WASM binary and the
related code...
> 
> It seems this is because the pkg/ directory, which is generated by
wasm-pack, contains .gitignore, and accordingly npm pack ignores it.

`wasm-pack` already addressed it by adding `--no-gitignore` option, but
it was not available yet at the time of the PR. Now that the version is
released, let's switch to it. (This requires us to update `wasm-pack` on
local, while CI always uses the latest
